candidates.original_title: Separate personality traits from states to predict future depression
candidates.description: Clark et al. (2003) found that both the changeable state and stable trait components of SNAP personality scales predict depressive symptoms in recurrent major depressive disorder patients receiving cognitive therapy.
candidates.citation_sentence: Using a new, larger data set of patients with recurrent depression treated with acute-phase CT [24], we aimed to replicate and extend Clark et al.'s (2003) findings.
